item.title: House Clash, Biometric Voter Cards, Child Protection
item.ns0:title: House Clash, Biometric Voter Cards, Child Protection
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, proceedings in the House of Assembly erupt into a heated clash over the government's reported fiscal surplus and the National Investment Fund, forcing a brief suspension of parliament. Meanwhile, the Parliamentary Registration Department rolls out a new local electoral management system to deliver faster biometric voter cards, as social services officials raise the alarm over a troubling surge in child neglect cases across the country. Plus, Potter's Cay Dock vendors voice mounting frustration over ongoing electrification delays, and National Security Minister Miles Larota defends the recent mass promotion of over 1,000 police officers despite public scrutiny. Tune in for all these top headlines, critical island infrastructure updates, local sports highlights, and your complete weather forecast!
